companyName: Aerostar Airport Holdings / Luis Muñoz Marín Airport
rationale: Aerostar Airport Holdings, LLC is the qualifying concessionaire and airport operator, distinct from the Puerto Rico Ports Authority-owned airport asset. ASUR currently holds 60%, while PSP Investments has a 40% look-through interest through wholly owned AviAlliance from the May 26, 2017 closing. Current 2026 evidence retains that 60/40 structure, and no later Aerostar ownership transfer or signed pending sale was found.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical Aerostar Airport Holdings, LLC company and use Aerostar and Aerostar Airport Holdings Puerto Rico as aliases.
Record ASUR as an active 60% owner and PSP Investments as an active 40% look-through owner through AviAlliance from May 26, 2017.
Retire the two Highstar/Oaktree vehicles at the May 26, 2017 closing without inferring their undisclosed individual portions of the former aggregate 50% interest.
Preserve the boundary between Aerostar as concessionaire/operator and the PRPA-owned Luis Muñoz Marín airport asset.
Do not treat Aena's 2026 Augusta transaction or AviAlliance's other airport transactions as Aerostar ownership events.
unresolvedQuestions: The original 50% split between the two Highstar/Oaktree vehicles is not publicly disclosed.
Private member-register detail is unavailable, but PSP's 40% beneficial position through AviAlliance is directly supported.
